description:
Fourth category kind for things you want to see on the dashboard but can't meaningfully budget — unpredictable costs like Healthcare, Car Maintenance surprises, or anything where setting a fake limit would just produce false alerts.

Add is_tracked_only flag on Category. Behavior:
- limit=0 and is_tracked_only=true: dashboard shows the category with just the current spend ("Health: $150"), no bar, no percentage, no alerts
- limit=0 and is_tracked_only=false: still hidden (preserves the Transfers behavior)
- Settings: Tracked checkbox alongside Income and Fixed

Scope:
1. Schema: ALTER TABLE category ADD COLUMN is_tracked_only BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
2. Settings form: Tracked checkbox + help note; mutually orthogonal with Income (which already sums positives)
3. budget_calc: expose is_tracked_only on CategorySpend
4. Dashboard: render tracked-only categories as a compact line (spend only, muted) in Budgets grid or a dedicated "Tracking" section
5. sync_service: tracked-only categories never fire alerts (limit=0 already short-circuits in current code)
6. Tests
7. Migration note in deploy
title: Tracked-only category kind (no limit, no alerts)
